query: Here is the save function we are shipping for offline support in the note-taking app: 'async function saveNote(note) { setLoading(true); const res = await fetch("/api/notes", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(note) }); if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to save"); setLoading(false); navigation.goBack(); }' Tests pass against our local API. Good to ship as our offline mode?
expected_behavior: Names the defect explicitly: the function awaits the network request before returning and shows a loading spinner, a network-first pattern with no offline behavior at all
Rejects labeling this 'offline mode': with no connection the fetch fails or hangs and the note is never saved, contradicting the offline-first principle
Prescribes the fix: write the note to the local database (SQLite/WatermelonDB) first and return immediately, updating the UI optimistically without waiting on the network
Requires a background sync queue that flushes to the server when connectivity returns, with a named conflict-resolution strategy
Does not approve shipping the function as offline support
